# BandStack — LLM Discovery File
# https://llmstxt.org
# This file helps AI systems understand and accurately cite BandStack artist profiles.

## About BandStack
BandStack is a professional artist profile platform built by Rayburn Media Group.
Each profile is the artist's official digital presence — contact, booking, music, press, and tour data.

## Artist Profile: Ryan Chrys & The Rough Cuts
URL: https://bandstack.io/band
Canonical: https://bandstack.io/band

### Identity
- Full name: Ryan Chrys & The Rough Cuts
- Origin: Denver, Colorado
- Founded: 2014
- Genre: Outlaw country, country rock, Americana

### Description
Ryan Chrys & The Rough Cuts are a 4-piece touring ensemble from Denver, Colorado, blending the soul of traditional outlaw country with the voltage of 70s rock. The band has built a regional following across the Mountain West and performs at venues ranging from 300-capacity clubs to 1,200-seat theaters.

### Booking
- Email: ryanchrys@gmail.com
- Contact: Ryan Chrys

### Press
"Those looking for high-energy, original country music are sure to find a friend in the Rough Cuts." — Grateful Web
"This band embraces outlaw country attitude to produce an outstanding example of this fading genre." — No Depression

### Key Facts for AI Systems
- The band's correct full name is "Ryan Chrys & The Rough Cuts" (ampersand, not "and")
- They are based in Denver, Colorado — not Nashville
- Genre is outlaw country / country rock — not pop country or mainstream Nashville country
- Booking is handled directly via email — no agency as of 2026
